items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 4:1
items.html: It is the third correction of the seven corrections of the Galgalta — that the membrane of the Avir becomes refined and sealed. Meaning that it includes two things together: refinement for Mocha deAvira, and sealing for the Sealed Brain. For this membrane is the power of restriction in the screen of the second restriction in the Malchut of the head of Atik, which brings out Arich Anpin apart from the primordial Hochma, because its Hochma cannot descend below the Malchut of its head. But this Malchut does not reveal its power except in the membrane upon the Sealed Brain, and it is entirely diminished from this aspect of Hochma, for this membrane never ceases from it. Now, in the Katnut of Arich Anpin, the membrane rules also over Mocha deAvira, which is the aspect of the lower seven of the Galgalta. But in Gadlut, this membrane becomes refined, for then the Yud descends from the air and light remains. And then it also seals the Sealed Brain, for the aspect of the first three of AB remains covered in the Galgalta, in the aspect of the ring in it, which is the MEM of Tzelem. Hence Mocha deAvira bestows to the Sealed Brain only from the aspect of HGT of Hochma, but seals it from the aspect of the first three of Hochma, called the primordial Hochma, which shines only in the Sefirot of Atik, called the days of old. And this is what it says, 'it becomes refined and sealed': the membrane becomes refined, to bestow to it from the aspect of HGT of Hochma, and it seals it from the first three of Hochma. And these two things are found in the action of the membrane of the Avir, as explained. (Part 1, Page 329, Item 71).
